card.name: Academic affiliations and titles in news
card.fires_on: Words inside academic affiliation and title phrases, such as 'Carolina' after University of North, 'co' before -director or -investigator, and 'of' or 'the' after a professor title. Also fires on some place names in geography lists.

modes.label: University names
modes.description: Fires on a word within a university or school name in a research news story.
modes.example: research from the University of North<< Carolina>> School of Medicine has established the first link

modes.label: Co- titles
modes.description: Fires on 'co' beginning a hyphenated role such as co-director or co-investigator.
modes.example: David Bassett Jr. is<< co>>-director of the Obesity Research Center and

modes.label: Linking words after professor titles
modes.description: Fires on a small linking word between a professor title and a department or school.
modes.example: clinical assistant professor in<< the>> Sam M. Walton College of Business.

card.writes: Promotes odd name-ending fragments and suppresses other name pieces, so it gives no clear next-word guidance.
card.plain: It marks the middle of a researcher's job title or university name, as in a news byline about a study.
